description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTrackerLogsController class, which manages the presentation and access control for employee performance tracker logs within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It extends a base Vue controller and implements access capabilities, utilizing traits for performance tracking and user role management.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerLogsController
classes.description: Controller for displaying and controlling access to employee performance tracker logs within the HRM system. Handles pre-render setup and permission checks.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component with performance tracker data for rendering, retrieving tracker info by ID from the request.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view the performance tracker logs for a given employee, throwing an exception if not authorized or record not found.
